# ggaction

ggaction is a JavaScript chart-authoring library built around immutable, hierarchical actions. Start with the smallest
route that matches the task instead of loading the full documentation bundle.

## Read in this order

1. Library model and retrieval workflow: ./llms/index.md
2. Choose an action family and find exact signatures: ./llms/actions.md
3. Follow a task-centered chart recipe: ./llms/recipes.md
4. Find tutorials, concepts, rendering, support, and extension docs: ./llms/docs.md

The generated canonical-order full-text fallback is ./llms-full.txt. Use it only when the four selective routes do not
identify the needed page.

## Essential invariants

- Every action accepts one option object and returns a new ChartProgram.
- Earlier programs and caller-owned inputs remain unchanged.
- semanticSpec records chart meaning; graphicSpec stores fully materialized backend-neutral graphics.
- Domain actions perform their own materialization; renderers read only graphicSpec.
- Resolve targets explicitly whenever stored state does not identify one unique dataset, mark, scale, coordinate, or view.
- Only methods declared on the public ChartProgram TypeScript type are supported direct-call actions.
